claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates have risen back above 6%.
As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates averaged approximately 6.25% to 6.38%.
30-year fixed mortgage rates dipped below 6% in February 2026.
According to Freddie Mac and Mortgage News Daily, the average 30-year fixed mortgage rate hovered around 6.25%–6.38% in March 2026.
According to Freddie Mac and Mortgage News Daily, 30-year fixed mortgage rates had a low of 5.98% in late February 2026.
Some lenders offer 15-year fixed mortgage rates around 5.75%–5.89% according to Bank of America and Bankrate.
5/6-month ARMs are appearing in the high 5% to low 6% range according to The Seattle Times and Bank of America.
5/6-month ARMs offer a lower initial rate for 3 to 10 years according to The Seattle Times and Bank of America.
Inflationary pressures and geopolitical tensions have boosted bond yields.
Ongoing tensions in the Middle East have influenced oil prices.
A $750,000 loan at 6.5% rather than 6% costs roughly $244 more per month.
